question: Identify the synonym of 'Gracious':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Polite**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Gracious"** means courteous, kind, and pleasant. It is associated with showing kindness or goodwill to others. (दयालु, कृपालु)
 
 
• **Example:** The host was gracious enough to make everyone feel comfortable during the party.
 
 
• **"Polite"** refers to someone who shows good manners and respect towards others. It often overlaps with being gracious. (विनम्र)
 
 
• **Example:** The polite child thanked the teacher for her guidance.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym for **"Gracious"** is **"Polite"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Polite**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rude** (अशिष्ट): Lacking manners or respect; offensive in speech or behavior.
 
 
• **Example:** His rude comments made everyone uncomfortable.
 
 
• **Selfish** (स्वार्थी): Concerned primarily with one's own interests, often disregarding others.
 
 
• **Example:** A selfish person rarely thinks about the needs of others.
 
 
• **Indifferent** (उदासीन): Having no particular interest or concern; apathetic.
 
 
• **Example:** He seemed indifferent to the outcome of the match.
 

32:T8d5,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
